cosplay.character: Sarah Kerrigan as a Ghost agent

cuts.head: with_body
cuts.ofreeRecent: a medieval tavern — seated on a chair; a bridal room — holds a small bouquet in both hands at her waist; a hydroponic garden dome aboard a starship — standing; a stage under a painted night sky of crystal stars — lying on her front; a present-day seaside arcade with a glass prize-claw machine filled with folded plush stars — using the claw-machine joystick with a sharpshooter’s patience; a lantern-lit old-town street at night — standing; an indoor climbing wall of coloured holds — kneeling on the ground; a far-future orbital hotel recreation pool under a transparent observation dome — trying the low-gravity relaxation deck after a swim; the stone stairway up to an old city gate tower — sweeps the floor beside her with a small hand brush; a walkway through a forest dome inside a colony ship — sketches in a sketchbook and pencil; a sunny beach with wet sand and shallow surf — sitting on the ground; the deck of a tall wooden sailing ship at sea — holds her keepsake at chest height; the driver's seat of a small car parked on a quiet street — holds a cup in both hands
